# Fallout TV series: New trailer, Xbox controller and Xbox background of the new Amazon Prime show

A new trailer for the new Fallout TV show has just been released on Amazon Prime. The official **release date of the series is now April 11, 2024**. At this point you can watch all episodes of the first season on Amazon Prime. The launch date was previously known as April 12, 2024.

You can already watch the series: Save it to your Prime Watchlist now *

## Xbox Design Lab Controllers

 You can design your Fallout Xbox controller here: https://xboxdesignlab.xbox.com/de-de

## Fallout TV Show: Dynamic Xbox Background

In keeping with the Fallout Prime TV series, you can now set up a dynamic background on your Xbox in which Lucy walks through the open Vault 33 into the wasteland.
